candidate_pool.title: 口是心非
candidate_pool.source_evidence: Actual CN song page: title/artist/album match; displayed date 1997-10-16; 张雨生 credited voice/composer/lyrics. Album row showed 4:52 and catalogue copyright 2025; not used to infer a new recording. No Live/Remix suffix.
candidate_pool.reason: 以同名专辑中的张雨生录音作为华语入口，借页面标示的 10 月 16 日发行日重听演唱的张力。重点不是孤立欣赏高音，而是比较字头、长句、人声位置与流行摇滚伴奏密度怎样共同形成推进。
candidate_pool.scope: actual CN song resource identity and version verified; original listening guide; no full playback claim

candidate_pool.title: Coyote
candidate_pool.source_evidence: Actual CN song page: title Coyote, Joni Mitchell, Hejira, displayed 1976-11-22. Credits observed: Joni voice/rhythm guitar; Jaco Pastorius fretless bass; Larry Carlton lead guitar; Bobbye Hall percussion.
candidate_pool.reason: 选择《Hejira》专辑录音，避开现场与 demo 条目。作者的伸缩句法、吉他的起音和无品低音的流动形成多条可跟随的线，适合把低音从背景节拍提升为独立旋律来听。
candidate_pool.scope: actual CN song resource identity and version verified; original listening guide; no full playback claim

candidate_pool.title: Two Thousand and Seventeen
candidate_pool.source_evidence: Actual CN song page: exact title, Four Tet, Two Thousand and Seventeen - Single, 2017-07-05. Credits: Four Tet programming; Kieran Hebden composer/producer. No identity of a specific acoustic instrument inferred from sound.
candidate_pool.reason: 选择独立单曲条目而非混音串烧版本。以明亮短音、余音和电子节奏的层次关系为入口，比较旋律持续重复时，织体变化怎样仍然带来方向感；不臆造具体声源或采样出处。
candidate_pool.scope: actual CN song resource identity and version verified; original listening guide; no full playback claim

candidate_pool.title: Orpheus
candidate_pool.source_evidence: Actual CN song page title/artist/album read; displayed original date 1987-11-07. Credits: David Sylvian voice/synth/acoustic guitar, Ryuichi Sakamoto synth, Steve Jansen drums, Danny Thompson double bass, P Palmer guitar, B Gascoigne orchestral arrangement. Album explicitly Remastered 2003, no new-performance claim.
candidate_pool.reason: 明确选择 2003 重制版的专辑资源，不与新录音混淆。低沉人声、原声与电子材质、低音提琴和管弦编排提供相互衬托的空间，适合练习听起音、持续与留白的比例。
candidate_pool.scope: actual CN song resource identity and version verified; original listening guide; no full playback claim

candidate_pool.title: Sodade
candidate_pool.source_evidence: Actual CN song page title/artist/album verified; original date displayed 1992-06-01; solo Cesária Evora resource, not duet, live, club remix or cover. Anniversary edition is preserved explicitly; personal-account full playback not tested.
candidate_pool.reason: 以明确标示的周年发行版独唱条目拓展到佛得角 morna，不混用二重唱、现场或重混版本。听轻摆脉冲、带沙质的人声边缘和句尾留白，先描述具体声音，再形成情绪判断。
candidate_pool.scope: actual CN song resource identity and version verified; original listening guide; no full playback claim
